At least three years experience in the concerned speciality as Senior Resident/Registrar/Tutor/Demonstrator in a recognised Medical College/Teaching Institution after the requisite post graduate degree. Knowledge of Konkani. Desirable: Knowledge of Marathi. content_sections.heading: GPSC Goa Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: After filling the application form, candidates pay the application fee in one of two ways. The notice does not print the fee amounts. Online: make the online payment and download the e-receipt showing successful status. Offline: generate an e-challan and make cash payment at any SBI Branch situated in Goa only, on or before the last date. The e-challan is valid for seven days from generation, a bank stamp on it is essential, and the stamped e-challan must be produced to the Commission's office on or before the last date of submission. Applications where fee payment is made after the last date will be summarily rejected and no refund will be provided. The application form can be downloaded only after successful payment.

content_sections.heading: GPSC Goa Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Shortlisting: where the number of applications received is large, the Commission will short list candidates to be called for interview, as mentioned in the Instructions on its website. Interview: the prescribed essential qualifications are minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. For the Assistant Professor in Science and Humanities (Chemistry) post, the notice says the academic score under the UGC Regulations, 2018 is considered for shortlisting for interview only, and selection is based only on performance in the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for GPSC Goa Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Read the Instructions available on the Commission's website https://gpsc.goa.gov.in before filling the application. Apply online through the Commission's website https://gpsc.goa.gov.in or the Government of Goa portal https://cbes.goa.gov.in/ . Give an email address and mobile number in the application form; the Commission sends all communications through them. Pay the application fee online and download the e-receipt, or generate an e-challan and pay cash at an SBI Branch in Goa. For offline payment, produce the bank-stamped e-challan at the Commission's office on or before the last date. Download the application form after successful payment. The last date is 27.11.2026 for all posts other than the deputation post, and 27.12.2026 for the deputation post only.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are in GPSC Goa Advertisement No. 11 Year 2026?
faq.answer: The notice lists 48 posts across 18 posts, including 20 Assistant Public Prosecutor posts, 9 Lecturer posts and 7 Assistant Professor posts in engineering disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 27.11.2026 for all posts other than the post by transfer on deputation. For the transfer on deputation post only, it is 27.12.2026.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GPSC Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through https://gpsc.goa.gov.in or the Government of Goa portal https://cbes.goa.gov.in/, after reading the Instructions on the Commission's website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: For direct recruitment posts the age limit is not exceeding 45 years. The notice prints no age limit for the deputation post.

faq.question: Q5. Is knowledge of Konkani required?
faq.answer: Yes, knowledge of Konkani is listed as essential for the direct recruitment posts, and knowledge of Marathi is desirable. The Commission may recommend an otherwise fit candidate if suitable candidates with Konkani are not available.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification for Assistant Public Prosecutor?
faq.answer: A degree in Law from a recognised University or equivalent, practice as an Advocate for two years, and knowledge of Konkani are essential.

faq.question: Q7. How is the application fee paid?
faq.answer: The fee is paid online with an e-receipt, or by e-challan with cash payment at any SBI Branch in Goa on or before the last date. Late payment leads to rejection with no refund.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are called for interview, with shortlisting by the Commission where applications are large. Possessing the prescribed qualifications alone does not entitle a candidate to be called.

faq.question: Q9. Is any Assistant Public Prosecutor post reserved for persons with disabilities?
faq.answer: Yes, 1 of the 20 Assistant Public Prosecutor posts is reserved for PwD (Blindness and low vision).

faq.question: Q10. What is the pay level for the Associate Professor posts?
faq.answer: The Associate Professor posts in Electrical and Electronics Engineering and Information Technology carry pay as per pay matrix level 13-A1.
